headline: UBS Downgrades MarketAxess Holdings to Neutral, Lowers Price Target to $167
summary: UBS  analyst Alex Kramm   downgrades MarketAxess Holdings (NASDAQ:MKTX) from Buy to Neutral and lowers the price target from $200 to $167.
